about: In the Feldip Hunter area among the crimson swifts, with 63 Hunter (three traps), five bird snares and five box traps, for the Hunter steps.
notes: Crimson swifts here (npc-spawns/hunter-birds.json); tropical wagtails (19) at ::tele 2512 2905. Golden warblers (5): ::tele 3402 3150 (Uzer). Copper longtails (9): ::tele 2340 3590 (Piscatoris). Cerulean twitches (11): ::tele 2725 3770 (Rellekka). Carnivorous chinchompas (63): ::tele 2556 2925 (Feldip), ::tele 2520 9296 (under it). Ferrets (27): ::tele 2313 3510; chinchompas (53): ::tele 2340 3595 (both Piscatoris). Lower Hunter with ::setlevel to see the trap count (2 below 40) and the catches a low level always misses. The loadout is ours.
